analyst_view.overall: Early view: third-placed Atlético (four wins in their last five) host a Valencia side 19th on 9 points and fighting relegation under Javier Aguirre, who took over in October. Atlético play at PSV on the Wednesday before, so some rotation is possible. José Gayà's red card against Real Madrid should be served long before 13 December; the date may still move.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.8 goals. I lean slightly lower: Aguirre has set Valencia up with a back five and a deep block, and they scored only once in their last two league games. Atlético may also manage the game after the trip to Eindhoven.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.7 corners. I lean a little higher: against a Valencia back five Atlético should have long spells of pressure in wide areas, which tends to push the home corner count up.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.2 cards. I lean slightly higher: a relegation-threatened Valencia defending deep for long periods means plenty of tactical fouls, and Valencia need points badly.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.7 shots. I lean a bit lower: Valencia's attack is weak (only 3 goals at Mestalla per one preview) and expecting almost 10 shots from them away at Atlético looks generous.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.4 shots on target. Nothing clear points either way this far out: Atlético should create plenty, but a packed Valencia box usually blocks a lot of efforts.
